number: Relabel at 3 rounds (flags 11 vs 12, delta 7). (a) Conservative word-level activity simulation (a call is active if any input differs; all four outputs then differ): without absorption 5, 8, 8 active G calls in rounds 0, 1, 2 and 8 of 8 digest words active, i.e. 8 conditions = 256 bits (the claim holds at 3 rounds). Delta 7 touches column 3 and all four diagonals. (b) With the exact in-call cancellation by m6/m7 (a1' = a1 ^ 7, m6' = m6 + e, m7' = m7 - e): round-0 state equal, 0, 6, 8 active calls, 8 of 8 digest words active at 3 rounds (8 equal at 1 round). (c) Exact digest pairs, 1500 random messages: 0 equal digest words at rounds 1 (uncancelled), 2 and 3; cancelled: 8 equal at 1 round, 0 at 2 and 3. (d) Bias of the 256 digest difference bits, 6000 pairs: uncancelled r1 63 biased bits, r2 and r3 none; cancelled r1 256, r2 17 biased bits in 4 words (max deviation 0.14), r3 none (max deviation 0.018, below the 0.05 threshold). At 3 rounds the flag door leaves no usable structure: 256-bit residual against 128 for birthday.
